desc: The Raptor II Semi-Automatic shotgun from TriStar Arms is where function and reliability meet beauty and affordability. Boasting a new aged and totally redesigned stock and forearm, the Raptor II is sleek and comfortable to shoot. Upgrades include a redesigned stock and forearm, oversized operating handle and bolt release, softer recoil pad and a fiber optic sight. Rigorously tested, the Raptor II offers the total package at an affordable price. Offered in 12ga, 20ga and Youth 20ga in Synthetic, Camo and Wood. The Raptor II by TriStar resets expectations and delivers performance.
